devdoc.details: The functionality from LockReleaseTokenPool.sol has been duplicated due to lack of compiler support for shared constructors between parentsThe primary token mechanism in this pool is Burn/Mint with CCTP, with Lock/Release as the secondary, opt in mechanism for chains not currently supporting CCTP.

params.remoteChainSelector: The remote chain selector for which the remote pool address is being added.
params.remotePoolAddress: The address of the new remote pool.

params.chainsToAdd: A list of chains and their new permission status & rate limits. Rate limits are only used when the chain is being added through `allowed` being true.
params.remoteChainSelectorsToRemove: A list of chain selectors to remove.

burnLockedUSDC().details: This function can only be called by an address specified by the owner to be controlled by circleproposeCCTPMigration must be called first on an approved lane to execute properly.This function signature should NEVER be overwritten, otherwise it will be unable to be called by circle to properly migrate USDC over to CCTP.

excludeTokensFromBurn(uint64,uint256).details: When a message is sitting in manual execution from the L/R chain, those tokens need to be excluded from being burned in a CCTP-migration otherwise the message will never be able to be delivered due to it not having an attestation on the source-chain to mint. In that instance it should use provided liquidity that was designatedThis function should ONLY be called on the home chain, where tokens are locked, NOT on the remote chain and strict scrutiny should be applied to ensure that the amount of tokens excluded is accurate.

returns._0: true is enabled, false if not.
uint64 the chain selector of the lane to be migrated. Will be zero if no proposal currently exists

getExcludedTokensByChain(uint64).details: The sum of locked tokens and excluded tokens should equal the supply of the token on the remote chain

params.remoteChainSelector: The chain for which the excluded tokens are being queried

returns._0: uint256 amount of tokens excluded from being burned in a CCTP-migration

proposeCCTPMigration(uint64).details: This function can only be called by the owner

params.remoteChainSelector: the CCIP specific selector for the remote chain currently using a non-canonical form of USDC which they wish to update to canonical. Function will revert if an existing migration proposal is already in progress.

provideLiquidity(uint64,uint256).details: Liquidity is expected to be added on a per chain basis. Parties are expected to provide liquidity for their own chain which implements non canonical USDC and liquidity is not shared across lanes.Once liquidity is added, it is locked in the pool until it is removed by an incoming message on the lock release mechanism. This is a hard requirement by Circle to ensure parity with the destination chain supply is maintained.

params.amount: The amount of tokens to provide as liquidity.
params.remoteChainSelector: The chain for which liquidity is provided to. Necessary to ensure there's accurate parity between locked USDC in this contract and the circulating supply on the remote chain

params.outboundConfig: The new outbound rate limiter config, meaning the onRamp rate limits for the given chain.

transferLiquidity(address,uint64).details: When upgrading a LockRelease pool, this function can be called at the same time as the pool is changed in the TokenAdminRegistry. This allows for a smooth transition of both liquidity and transactions to the new pool. Alternatively, when no multicall is available, a portion of the funds can be transferred to the new pool before changing which pool CCIP uses, to ensure both pools can operate. Then the pool should be changed in the TokenAdminRegistry, which will activate the new pool. All new transactions will use the new pool and its liquidity.

params.from: The address of the old pool.
params.remoteChainSelector: The chain for which liquidity is being transferred.

params.to: The address to which ownership will be transferred.

params.adds: A list of chain selectors to enable LR instead of BM. These chains must not have been migrated to CCTP yet or the transaction will revert
params.removes: A list of chain selectors to disable Lock-Release, and enforce BM

withdrawLiquidity(uint64,uint256).details: The function should only be called if non canonical USDC on the remote chain has been burned and is not being withdrawn on this chain, otherwise a mismatch may occur between locked token balance and remote circulating supply which may block a potential future migration of the chain to CCTP.

params.amount: The amount of liquidity to remove.
params.remoteChainSelector: The chain where liquidity is being released.

acceptOwnership().notice: Allows an ownership transfer to be completed by the recipient.

addRemotePool(uint64,bytes).notice: Adds a remote pool for a given chain selector. This could be due to a pool being upgraded on the remote chain. We don't simply want to replace the old pool as there could still be valid inflight messages from the old pool. This function allows for multiple pools to be added for a single chain selector.

applyAllowListUpdates(address[],address[.notice: Apply updates to the allow list.

applyChainUpdates(uint64[],(uint64,bytes.notice: Sets the permissions for a list of chains selectors. Actual senders for these chains need to be allowed on the Router to interact with this pool.

burnLockedUSDC().notice: Burn USDC locked for a specific lane so that destination USDC can be converted from non-canonical to canonical USDC.

cancelExistingCCTPMigrationProposal().notice: Cancel an existing proposal to migrate a lane to CCTP.This function will revert if no proposal is currently in progress.

excludeTokensFromBurn(uint64,uint256).notice: Exclude tokens to be burned in a CCTP-migration because the amount are locked in an undelivered message.

getAllowListEnabled().notice: Gets whether the allowlist functionality is enabled.

getCurrentInboundRateLimiterState(uint64.notice: Gets the token bucket with its values for the block it was requested at.

getCurrentOutboundRateLimiterState(uint6.notice: Gets the token bucket with its values for the block it was requested at.

proposeCCTPMigration(uint64).notice: Propose a destination chain to migrate from lock/release mechanism to CCTP enabled burn/mint through a Circle controlled burn.

transferLiquidity(address,uint64).notice: This function can be used to transfer liquidity from an older version of the pool to this pool. To do so this pool must be the owner of the old pool. Since the pool uses two-step ownership transfer, the old pool must first propose the ownership transfer, and then this pool must accept it. This function can only be called after the ownership transfer has been proposed, as it will accept it and then make the call to withdrawLiquidity

transferOwnership(address).notice: Allows an owner to begin transferring ownership to a new address. The new owner needs to call `acceptOwnership` to accept the transfer before any permissions are changed.

updateChainSelectorMechanisms(uint64[],u.notice: Updates designations for chains on whether to use primary or alt mechanism on CCIP messages

withdrawLiquidity(uint64,uint256).notice: Removed liquidity to the pool. The tokens will be sent to msg.sender.

userdoc.notice: A token pool for USDC which uses CCTP for supported chains and Lock/Release for all others
